title: SkillAtlas: An Attack Trace Library for Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2609.13353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills are reusable units for language-model agents, but their risks emerge through model decisions, user context, tool calls, and execution feedback rather than through stable signatures or a single sandbox run. Existing static, dynamic, and benchmark-style evaluations rarely preserve public evidence that can be inspected, searched, and reused. We present SkillAtlas, a hosted attack trace library that converts private agent-skill security report bundles into reviewed, redacted, and searchable public cases. The library contains 3,014 cases, 6,589 traces, 151,131 steps, 233 affected skills, and 8 risk categories; 42.5% of successful cases first become successful after a non-success initial round, and trajectory-grounded labels improve pre-execution guard accuracy to 0.770.

translated_title: SkillAtlas：面向智能体技能的攻击轨迹库
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是语言模型智能体的可复用单元，但其风险是通过模型决策、用户上下文、工具调用和执行反馈逐步显现的，而非依赖于稳定签名或单次沙箱运行。现有的静态、动态和基准式评估方法很少保留可供检查、搜索和复用的公开证据。我们提出了SkillAtlas，这是一个托管的攻击轨迹库，可将私有的智能体技能安全报告包转换为经过审核、脱敏且可搜索的公开案例。该库包含3,014个案例、6,589条轨迹、151,131个步骤、233个受影响技能以及8个风险类别；其中42.5%的成功案例是在初始轮次失败后才首次成功的，而基于轨迹的标签可将执行前防护的准确率提升至0.770。
tldr: 该论文提出SkillAtlas，一个将私有智能体技能安全报告转化为经审核、脱敏且可搜索公开案例的攻击轨迹库（含3,014个案例），并证明基于轨迹的标签可将执行前防护准确率提升至0.770。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SkillAtlas, a hosted attack trace library that converts private agent-skill security reports into reviewed, redacted, and searchable public cases (3,014 cases), demonstrating that trajectory-grounded labels improve pre-execution guard accuracy to 0.770.
